title: Metallic Boots
html:
Metallic Boots are a common pair of Boots.

Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.

Properties

  •  Boots
  • Required Proficiency:  Medium Armour
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 2 kg (4 lb)
  •  Price: 30 gp
  • UID ARM_Boots_Metal_A
    UUID aa4be0b4-e2f7-4e22-a708-249276fe47f7
    Stats ARM_Boots_Metal
    File ARM_Footwear_Metal_A

Special

The wearer of this item gains:

  •  Athletics +1

Where to find

  • Sold by the following traders:
    •  Dammon in the Druid Grove
    •  Roah Moonglow in the Shattered Sanctum
  • Worn by several characters throughout the game
